# Repository metadata

Description: Offline-capable woodchopping prediction and handicap engine. Trusted V2 production core plus an auditable V3 adaptive-ensemble release candidate with competition-scoped contracts. V3 is not production-eligible.

Website: https://pypi.org/project/strathmark/

Topics: `timbersports`, `woodchopping`, `handicap`, `handicapping`, `python`, `sports-analytics`, `prediction`, `monte-carlo`, `fastapi`, `offline-first`, `calculation-engine`, `auditability`.

The About panel describes the current V2/V3 boundaries. Model backends are optional implementation details, not a universal numeric cascade. Governing competition rules remain competition-specific. Use `assets/strathmark_logo.png` for the social preview.
